purpose: Define the audit trail schema for living falsification campaigns so every patch, evidence report, status change, and textbook update remains traceable.

entries.entry_type: enum(PATCH, MATH_SPEC, SIM_CONFIG, SIM_RESULT, EVIDENCE_REPORT, TEXTBOOK_UPDATE, CLAIM_LEVEL_CHANGE, REVIEW_LOCK, RETIREMENT, REWRITE)

governance_rules.rule: Prior audit entries may not be deleted or overwritten. Corrections must be added as new entries referencing the corrected entry.
Every textbook update generated by the campaign must create a matching audit entry, and every evidence report that changes status must create a textbook update proposal.
If OPEN_BRIDGE_001 enters FALSIFIED_OR_REWRITE_REQUIRED, all listed downstream review targets must receive REVIEW_LOCK audit entries.
